translation.name: Biblica® Se aɖeke mebla Biblia zazã o Agbenya La™

content.text: Mègadzo nyanyanya le ame vɔ̃ɖiwo ta,
alo aʋã ŋu nu tovo wɔlawo o
elabena esusɔ vie woayrɔ abe gbe ene,
eye abe gbe mumu ene la, woaku wo atsɔ aƒu gbe.
Ɖo dzi ɖe Yehowa ŋu, eye nàwɔ nyui;
nɔ anyigba la dzi, eye nàɖu eƒe nu nyuiwo le dziɖeɖi me.
Yehowa ƒe nu nenyo ŋuwò ekema ana nu
siwo wò dzi di la wò.
Tsɔ wò mɔwo gblẽ ɖe Yehowa ƒe asi me;
ɖo dzi ɖe eŋu, eye awɔ esia na wò.
Ana wò dzɔdzɔenyenye nàdze abe ŋdikekeli ene,
eye wò dzɔdzɔenyenye ƒe mɔ abe ŋdɔkutsuɣe ene.
Zi kpoo le Yehowa ŋkume,
eye nànɔ eƒe asinu kpɔm le dzigbɔɖi me.
Ne amewo ƒe mɔwo dze edzi na wo,
eye wote ŋu wɔ nu vɔ̃ɖi siwo woɖo la,
mègavɔ̃ nàdzo nyanyanya o.
Ɖe asi le dziku ŋu, eye nàtrɔ megbe de wò dɔmedzoe,
ŋɔ megadzi wò o,
elabena nu vɔ̃ɖi me ko wòakplɔ wò ayii.
Woatsrɔ̃ ame vlowo
gake ame siwo tsɔ woƒe mɔkpɔkpɔ de
Yehowa me la, anyi anyigba la ƒe dome.
Esusɔ vie ko ame vɔ̃ɖi la maganɔ anyi o,
togbɔ be àdi wo hã la, màkpɔ wo o.
Ke ame fafawo anyi anyigba la ƒe dome,
eye dzi adzɔ wo le ŋutifafa gbogbo la ta.
Ame vɔ̃ɖiwo ɖo nugbe ɖe
ame dzɔdzɔewo ŋu heɖu aɖukli ɖe wo ŋuti.
Ke Aƒetɔ la le ame vɔ̃ɖiwo kom,
elabena enya be woƒe ŋkeke la gbɔna.
Ame vɔ̃ɖiwo ɖe woƒe yi,
eye wohe woƒe dati me be woada hiãtɔ
kple ame dahe aƒu anyi,
eye woawu ame siwo ƒe zɔzɔme to mɔ ɖeka.
Gake woƒe yiwo aŋɔ woawo ŋutɔ ƒe dziwo,
eye woƒe datiwo aŋe.
Nu ʋɛ si le ame dzɔdzɔewo si la nyo wu
kesinɔnu gbogbo siwo le ame vɔ̃ɖiwo si,
elabena woaŋe ame vɔ̃ɖiwo ƒe ŋusẽ,
ke Yehowa alé ame dzɔdzɔewo ɖe te.
Ame siwo ŋuti fɔɖiɖi mele o la
ƒe ŋkekewo le nyanya na Yehowa,
eye woƒe domenyinu anɔ anyi tegbetegbe.
Le ŋkeke vɔ̃wo dzi la, womalũ xɛ o;
le dɔŋɔli la, nuɖuɖu ado agbogbo na woawo ya.
Ke ame vɔ̃ɖi ya atsrɔ̃.
Yehowa ƒe futɔwo anɔ abe gbe ƒe seƒoƒo ene,
woanya kpɔ nyuie, gake wo nu ava yi,
woabu abe dzudzɔ ene.
Ame vɔ̃ɖi doa nugbana, eye mexea fea o,
ke ame dzɔdzɔe ya naa nu faa.
Ame siwo Yehowa yra la anyi anyigba la ƒe dome,
ke ame siwo wòƒo fi de la, woaɖe wo ɖa.
Ŋutsu si ƒe mɔwo dze Yehowa ŋu la,
elia ke eƒe afɔɖeɖewo;
ne ekli nu hã la, madze anyi o
elabena Yehowa tsɔ eƒe asi lée ɖe te.
Tsã la, menye ɖevi, ke azɔ la metsi,
gake womegble ame dzɔdzɔe aɖeke ɖi mekpɔ kpɔ loo,
alo wo viwo nabia abolo hafi aɖu o.
Woawo boŋ vea ame nu ɣe sia ɣi,
eye wodoa nugbana na amewo faa;
eya ta wo viwo axɔ yayra.
Tsri nu vɔ̃ɖi, eye nàwɔ nyui
ekema ànɔ anyigba dzi tegbetegbe.
Elabena Yehowa lɔ̃a nu dzɔdzɔe wɔlawo,
eye magblẽ eƒe nuteƒewɔlawo ɖi o.
Akpɔ wo ta tegbee,
ke ame vɔ̃ɖi ƒe dzidzimeviwo ya woatsrɔ̃ wo.
Ame dzɔdzɔe anyi anyigba la ƒe dome,
eye wòanɔ edzi tegbee.
Nunyanya doa go tso ame dzɔdzɔe ƒe nu me,
eye eƒe aɖe gblɔa nu si le eteƒe.
Eƒe Mawu ƒe se le eƒe dzi me,
eya ta eƒe afɔ meɖiɖina o.
Ame vɔ̃ɖiwo de xa ɖi na ame dzɔdzɔewo,
eye wole woƒe ku dim;
gake Yehowa matsɔ wo agblẽ ɖe woƒe ŋusẽ te,
alo wòaɖe mɔ be, woabu fɔ wo ne wokplɔ wo va ʋɔnui o.
Lala nàkpɔ Yehowa ƒe asinu,
eye nàlé eƒe mɔ ɖe asi.
Ado wò ɖe dzi be nànyi anyigba la ƒe dome.
Ne woatsrɔ̃ ame vɔ̃ɖiwo la, àkpɔ eteƒe.
Mekpɔ ame vɔ̃ɖi,
ŋutasẽla aɖe wòda ama nyuie
abe ati dama si dzɔ kple anyigba la ene.
Gake eteƒe medidi o ko, enu va yi, eye megali o;
togbɔ be medii hã la, nyemeke ɖe eŋuti o.
Bu ame maɖifɔ la ŋu,
eye nàlé ŋku ɖe ame dzɔdzɔewo ŋu,
elabena ŋgɔgbe li na ŋutifafamewo katã.
Ke woatsrɔ̃ nu vɔ̃ wɔlawo katã,
eye woaɖe ame vɔ̃ɖi la ɖa.
Ame dzɔdzɔewo ƒe xɔxɔ atso Yehowa gbɔ,
eye eyae nye woƒe mɔ sesẽ le xaxaɣeyiɣiwo me.
Ke Yehowa kpena ɖe wo ŋu, eye wòɖea wo tso dzɔgbevɔ̃e me;
eɖea wo tso ame vɔ̃ɖiwo ƒe asi me,
eye wòkpena ɖe wo ŋu,
elabena eyae wosi tso.
